title: NIST WebBook: Urea is CH4N2O, molecular weight 60.0553 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Urea as CH4N2O, molecular weight 60.0553 amu, CAS 57-13-6.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Urea, CAS Registry Number 57-13-6, lists molecular formula CH4N2O and molecular weight 60.0553 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 60.0323628 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/CH4N2O/c2-1(3)4/h(H4,2,3,4). The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
